js: (()=>{const el=document.querySelector('#composer-input'); const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(el,'这段内容看起来属于量子计算实验，帮我切过去'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return 'typed';})()

(async()=>{const t0=Date.now(); while(Date.now()-t0<45000){const m=document.querySelector('[data-test="topic-approval-content"]'); if(m){const d=document.querySelector('[role="dialog"]'); const r=d.getBoundingClientRect(); const okLong=(d.innerText.match(/这段内容看起来属于/)||[]).length; return JSON.stringify({found:true,inner:(d.innerText).slice(0,700),docScrollW:document.documentElement.scrollWidth,winW:innerWidth,dialog:{l:Math.round(r.left),w:Math.round(r.width)},reasonChineseOk:okLong});} await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return 'no-modal';})()
